page.overview:
Who is Old Mother of Mount Li?

The is an immortal woman who lives on Mount Li.

As part of a test for Tang Sanzang and his disciples, Guanyin had the Old Mother pose as one of three beautiful brides alongside the Bodhisattva Manjushri and Samantabhadra.

Category:Females Category:Humans Category:Immortals Category:Taoism
